```bash
head -n 30 ./output/handbook.txt
```

If `pdftotext` is unavailable, install it on Ubuntu:

```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y poppler-utils
```

If the PDF is scanned or the output is empty, use OCR:

```bash
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y ocrmypdf tesseract-ocr poppler-utils

mkdir -p ./output
ocrmypdf --skip-text \
  ./uploads/handbook.pdf \
  ./output/handbook_ocr.pdf

pdftotext -layout \
  ./output/handbook_ocr.pdf \
  ./output/handbook.txt
```

To save beside the original uploaded PDF instead, replace `./output/handbook.txt` with `./uploads/handbook.txt`.
